item.text: {"question_id":"5B.2","answer":"The supplied evidence shows a mixed but limited record for 2023. China retained central-bank governor Yi Gang and finance minister Liu Kun beyond the official retirement age; Reuters reported that analysts viewed this as continuity, credibility, stability, and professionalism, but also noted that these were assessments rather than demonstrated independence or performance outcomes (BATCH-0006-E012). A 2023 State Council regulation prescribed qualifications and governance requirements for non-bank payment institutions, but it concerned regulated firms, was scheduled to take effect in 2024, and supplies no evidence about Xi's appointment, empowerment, or enforcement practices (BATCH-0021-E006; BATCH-0021-E007). The broader personnel evidence indicates that political loyalty and factional relationships affected appointments under Xi, while loyalty was only one of several patronage patterns and the evidence does not establish the basis of every individual appointment (BATCH-0006-E010; BATCH-0009-E004). The official reform communiqué also emphasized stronger central coordination and implementation of Party directives, but does not independently establish operational independence or performance-based personnel decisions (BATCH-0015-E002). Thus, continuity and some professional qualification signals are supported, but there is no supplied evidence of credible competitive appointment procedures, systematic performance-based retention or replacement, or operational independence from Party leadership.","supporting_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0006-E012","BATCH-0006-E010","BATCH-0015-E002"],"contrary_or_qualifying_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0009-E004","BATCH-0009-E005","BATCH-0005-E009","BATCH-0021-E006","BATCH-0021-E007"],"limitations_and_gaps":["No complete roster, appointment criteria, competitive-process record, dismissal record, performance review, or evidence of operational independence is supplied.","The Reuters professionalism and continuity assessments are analyst interpretations and do not establish later performance or independence.","The patronage and factional evidence concerns broader personnel patterns and does not prove that loyalty determined each economic appointment.","The payment-institution regulation was promulgated in 2023 but scheduled to take effect on May 1, 2024; it cannot establish 2023 implementation or enforcement.","The supplied evidence does not establish Xi's individual role in every retention or appointment decision. A separate study describes multiple patronage patterns and does not isolate a specific 2023 appointment or causal effect."],"corrections_made":["Removed the unsupported implication that retention itself demonstrated credible appointment, independence, or performance-based retention.","Reclassified the payment-institution regulation as contextual and temporally qualified rather than evidence of Xi's economic personnel decisions.","Qualified the inference from loyalist and factional appointments: the evidence supports a broader patronage and centralization concern, not proof that loyalty constrained the specific economic officials at issue.","Retained the positive continuity and professionalism evidence while distinguishing analyst interpretation from demonstrated outcomes.","Added the official reform communiqué as evidence of central coordination and directives, while preserving that it does not establish independence or implementation quality."],"reasons_to_reopen_full_ledger":["New evidence directly documenting appointment procedures, professional qualifications of specific economic officials, delegated authority, central-bank or ministry autonomy, and performance-based retention or dismissal would materially change the answer.","Evidence on actual 2023 implementation and enforcement of the payment-institution regulation should be reviewed separately from its formal adoption."]}
